note: The structural matrix. One row per destination, one column per facet. Facets describe the EVENING; properties of her PEOPLE belong to the tone tiles and are measured in voice space, never here. Audited by scripts/audit-matrix.mjs — never quote a failure list from anywhere else.

facetNotes.schedule: posted = the invitation names the hours. anchored = one thing happens AT ITS HOUR and the rest finds its own (Westhampton's drinks hour, New Orleans' second wind at midnight). standing = the house's own unannounced rhythms — nothing is named, but the night has always gone this way (Nantucket, Côte d'Azur's eternal lunch). unplanned = nobody decided anything; it became a party. anchored and standing were briefly ONE level on the argument that a host cannot tell them apart. That was wrong, and the collision proved it: Westhampton/Nantucket failed on [dress, food] with no schedule contribution, which is impossible if those two houses keep time differently — and they do. A named hour and an unnamed habit are different answers to 'does anything happen at a time?'
facetNotes.size: Pure headcount. few = 8 or under. table = 8 to 16. crowd = 16 and over. "One long table" is EVIDENCE for the middle band, never the definition — the furniture fact stays in the prose.
facetNotes.spectacle: performed = A SHOW THE ROOM WATCHES — a floor show, cliff divers, the band that is the point. EXCLUSION, written here because it will otherwise creep: a toast, or a carving at the table, is CEREMONY and not spectacle. The room attending to one person it knows is not an audience.

twinRule.statement: A room may sit below the gate against EXACTLY ONE other room — its twin — provided all four conditions hold.
conditions: distance >= 1. Zero is not a twin, it is one room written twice.
voice affinity < 0.65. The pair must be separable by the OTHER instrument; the tiebreak has to have something to work with.
the pair is DECLARED here as a tiebreak pair. An undeclared sub-gate pair is a failure, not a twin.
ONE TWIN PER ROOM. A room with two sub-gate partners cannot twin with either — that is a crowded corner, not a pair.
twinRule.why: Havana/New Orleans is the precedent instance and the reason the rule exists: the same night in shape, separated by 'nobody in the house is the target' against 'everybody is fair game', at 0.172 in voice space. Forcing a structural facet between them would smuggle a guest property back into the matrix. The twin rule says so out loud instead.
